meta.instruction: The player's chosen Primary Attribute (STR, DEX, or INT) determines their starting civilization and quest line.
meta.usage: Ingest the specific key matching the player's stat to retrieve the narrative path.

quests.title: The Guild Schism
quests.narrative_guidance: Grand Forger Avelin needs to reconcile the faith-based smiths and the profit-driven syndics before the guild collapses.
improvisation_points: Obtain the Sacred Cinder from Kael in Ignis Prime.
Secure the Industrial Seal from Orla in Bastion-Hammer.
Deliver both to Talo at the Ash-Cathedral for a binding ritual.

quests.title: Relic-Blade Recovery
quests.narrative_guidance: Hijacked shipments of ancient blades must be recovered and returned to the vaults.
improvisation_points: Investigate the theft report at the Hammer-Fall Docks with Thul.
Track the charcoal residue to Valer's ash chambers.
Reclaim the blades from the black market contact near Grigg.

quests.title: The Unbreakable Alloy
quests.narrative_guidance: Kara Veyne's vision of an unbreakable sword requires specialized materials from across the Hegemony.
improvisation_points: Collect pure molten slag from Brunt's arteries.
Obtain magnetic stabilizers from Kess in Bastion-Hammer.
Synthesize the alloy under the rhythmic heat of Bram's pistons.

quests.title: Scrubbing the Records
quests.narrative_guidance: Envoy Dresk needs certain illegal production logs to disappear before the High Hegemony conducts an audit.
improvisation_points: Intercept the physical ledgers from Marek's grate.
Bypass the cargo security with Horg's clearance codes.
Incinerate the records in the high-pressure vaults managed by Myra.

quests.title: The Star-Iron Eye
quests.narrative_guidance: Old Mirdan's vision is failing; he requires a new eye forged from fallen celestial metal.
improvisation_points: Consult the glass-shaping techniques of Elen at the observatory.
Charged the star-iron core using Vax's magnetic tethers.
Cool the finished ocular lens in the thermal vents monitored by Iona.

quests.title: The Saboteur's Script
quests.narrative_guidance: A secret message regarding corporate sabotage must be delivered across the city lines.
improvisation_points: Receive the coded message from Niv at the overlook.
Use Zek's flue-running paths to avoid Syndic patrols.
Drop the message at the lava-walk for the resistance under Jox's nose.

quests.title: Whisper in the Spire
quests.narrative_guidance: The Voice of Flame is screaming, and only a specific ritual can quiet the forge's rage.
improvisation_points: Perform the initial strike at Gid's altar.
Clear the soot-clogged spiritual filters with Pold.
Signal the docks' cranes under Thul to lift the containment lid.

quests.title: Schism of the Guild
quests.narrative_guidance: Resolve the growing tension between the production metrics of Aureole-Zero and the spiritual needs of the workers.
improvisation_points: Obtain the production logs from Nax Verr.
Take the logs to Sela Loom to see if the quotas are physically possible.
Deliver the final report to Kael Watch to stabilize the guild's hierarchy.

quests.title: Relic Blade Heist
quests.narrative_guidance: Ancient blades have been taken from the vaults. They must be recovered before they are sold to outsiders.
improvisation_points: Investigate the initial theft at the Ember-Well with Pyra Ember.
Track the mold signatures with Sol Mold to identify the specific relics stolen.
Secure the remaining records with Scribe Ink to prevent further leaks.

quests.title: The Unbreakable Blade
quests.narrative_guidance: Help Kara Veyne's team experiment with a new alloy that requires extreme kinetic force and stability.
improvisation_points: Gather raw materials from Jax Spin's sluices.
Ensure the corridors are clear for high-speed transport with Mira Slip.
Test the stability of the final forge on the Gyroscope Plazas with Oryn Gyro.

quests.title: Erasing the Evidence
quests.narrative_guidance: The Syndic needs potential proof of industrial negligence removed before an inspection.
improvisation_points: Locate the faulty chutes with Kyra Moss.
Re-align the spires with Eris Bolt to mask the magnetic residue.
Have Dorn Sledge crush the physical evidence into scrap at the Anvils.

quests.title: The Star-Iron Eye
quests.narrative_guidance: Construct a replacement eye for Old Mirdan using rare metals found within the high-velocity lines.
improvisation_points: Request the Star-Iron torque specifications from Vane Piston.
Intercept the material on the High-Velocity Assembly Lines from Lana Speed.
Have the eye frame mounted to the rigging gears by Tarn Gear.

quests.title: Smuggling Cursed Relics
quests.narrative_guidance: Lyra Ansel needs to move dangerous relics out of the reach of the High Ember's zealots.
improvisation_points: Collect the relics from the Ash-Wind Cloisters with Vesper Wind.
Use the soul-heat siphons with Thal Siphon to mask the relic's energy signature.
Receive the final blessing and passage from Nyx Prayer.

quests.title: The Hidden Spire Chamber
quests.narrative_guidance: The Voice of Flame has spoken of a hidden chamber containing the First Anvil.
improvisation_points: Use the Lens of Focus with Varlen Zephyr to reveal the hidden entrance.
Sift through the slag-catch nets with Krell Net to find the ancient key.
Enter the Crucible Depths and confirm the chamber with Morn Deep.

INT.civilization_target: The Pyre-Synod of the Hearth Forge

quests.title: The Solar Schism
quests.narrative_guidance: The Solar Siphon is malfunctioning, causing a power drop in the Mandrel. Recover the stolen focus lens to restore the heat.
improvisation_points: Consult Helios Vance about the power failure at the Siphon.
Secure the Great Mandrel from overheating with Thorne Ironshaper's tools.
Deliver the recovered star-lens to Kara Veyne for structural reinforcement.

quests.title: Secrets of the Glass-Steel
quests.narrative_guidance: Ancient transmutation scrolls have been stolen from the vaults. They must be recovered before they are turned into glass-steel weapons.
improvisation_points: Obtain the manifest of stolen scrolls from Alchemist Zora.
Seek a blessing of detection from Cantor Vane to find the thief.
Return the recovered scrolls to Glazier Finn to ensure the glass-steel remains stable.

quests.title: The Syndic's Shadow
quests.narrative_guidance: Confidential records from the Radiant Spine have leaked to the Promenade's black market. Erase the evidence.
improvisation_points: Get the list of leaked documents from Spark-Scribe Elara.
Track the documents through the waste tunnels with Overseer Kael.
Buy back or destroy the remaining copies from Merchant Jace's stall.

quests.title: Carbon Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: Lyra Ansel has hidden a message in a shipment that is about to be inspected by Syndic guards. Distract the observers.
improvisation_points: Meet Lyra Ansel to identify the tainted filament batch.
Consult Engineer Mira to trigger a steam diversion in the exchange pools.
Bribe or distract Astronomer Tycho to ensure the 'stars' don't align for the inspectors.

quests.title: The Weaver's Rhythm
quests.narrative_guidance: A rare fire-silk pattern requires the harmonic resonance of the steam organ to set correctly.
improvisation_points: Collect the raw fire-silk from Weaver Seraphina.
Coordinate the resonance frequency with Maestro Basso at the organ.
Use the resulting vibration to sift the finest scoria from Scrapper Jax's yard.

quests.title: Quench the Relic
quests.narrative_guidance: A legendary blade must be quenched in the purest flux to achieve its final form.
improvisation_points: Prepare the blade for quenching under Warden Grog's supervision.
Clear the shipping lanes at the docks with Harbormaster Silt for the arrival of the flux.
Have Caster Valerius bind the ash of the forge to the blade's edge.

quests.title: Guidance of the Hearth
quests.narrative_guidance: The Voice of Flame is calling for a purification ritual to clear the fumes and reveal a hidden vault.
improvisation_points: Collect the specialized air filters from Vent-Filter Nia.
Navigate the molten river to the source with Ferryman Char.
Present the filters to the Voice of Flame to hear the secret of the hidden chamber.
